name: Pandoc Crossref Preview
changes: The Pro notice for number profiles and label reports now has a Sponsor on GitHub button.
tip: Select a resolved figure or equation number to switch to source mode at its target line.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Pandoc Crossref Preview is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it in your writing.
